old_string:
DEFINES += BFREE_GUEST_HAS_QT6 QT_STATIC
# Guest Qt was built with linux-g++ / CROSS_COMPILE; bare x86_64-elf-g++ needs OS + libstdc++ paths.
DEFINES += __linux__ __x86_64__
new_string:
DEFINES += BFREE_GUEST_HAS_QT6 QT_STATIC
# Guest Qt was built with linux-g++ / CROSS_COMPILE; bare x86_64-elf-g++ needs OS + libstdc++ paths.
DEFINES += __linux__ __x86_64__
# musl __mmap must not fall back to Linux syscall 9 inside ring3 (B-Free case 9 is timerfd_pending).
DEFINES += BFREE_GUEST_NO_HOST_MMAP
